Name: Prairie King Starter Kit
Author: gulewei
Description:
[size=5][b]Prairie King: Starter Kit[/b] A clean mod that makes you get through Prairie King much easier.

[/size]You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/gulewei/StardewValleyPrairieKing]here[/url]

[color=#ffffff][b][size=5]✨ The Starter Kit[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]⚡ [b]Speed Boost (Coffee):[/b] Start with increased movement speed. Outrun the fastest monsters and weave through bullet patterns with ease.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]? [b]Wagon Wheel (8-Way Shot):[/b] Your gun fires in all 8 directions at once! This creates a 360-degree "no-fly zone" around your character, allowing you to dominate the map.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]⏳ [b]Persistent Power:[/b] Buff timers are extended (1000x duration), meaning you don't have to rush. Your starter buffs—and any you pick up—will last for the duration of the stage.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]? Important Tips & Mechanics[/b][/size]
[/color][size=3]To keep the mod lightweight and balanced, please keep these in mind:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]?️ [b]Saloon Exclusive:[/b] This mod is specifically designed for the Stardrop Saloon arcade machine. Head to the saloon to activate your power-ups![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]? [b]Death Resets the Buffs: [/b]These starting items are a "gift for the living." If you lose a life and respawn, your starting buffs will expire. You'll need to rely on your skill (and any permanent shop upgrades you've bought) to finish the stage![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]? [b]Achievement Friendly: [/b]This is the perfect companion for players chasing the Fector's Challenge achievement. It provides the early-game advantage needed to farm coins safely.[/size][/*]
[/list]
